traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md defines requirements for validating @story and @req annotation format and syntax, including path and ID patterns, multiline handling, flexible parsing, and specific error messages. These are implemented by the `valid-annotation-format` ESLint rule and its helpers in src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts and src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-*.ts, which are explicitly annotated with this story and the corresponding REQ IDs. The rule follows ESLint best practices (meta, schema, messages, fixable), scans all comments so it naturally works with annotations used by the function/branch rules, and provides clear, detailed error messages constructed via shared helpers. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts are explicitly tied to this story, cover both valid and invalid single-line and multi-line formats, path traversal, missing identifiers, configuration error handling, and auto-fix behavior, and all pass in the Jest run. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md describes the format specification, options, and examples of valid/invalid annotations consistent with the story. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied with concrete implementation and passing tests.
